terminals.name: watchdog-cloud
terminals.description: Watchdog Cloud preview on http://127.0.0.1:8787 only (do not publish). Skip start if /health already OK.
terminals.command: if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8787/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'Watchdog Cloud already listening on 8787'; exit 0; fi; exec ./node_modules/.bin/tsx packages/cloud/src/server.ts
